hero.title: Where Vietnamese students meet the world's schools
hero.lead: Capstone advises students and families in Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City, and helps schools and universities from abroad recruit in Vietnam.

servicesIntro.title: Advice from shortlist to arrival
servicesIntro.intro: We match each student's background, interests, finances and goals with the right schools, and we explain our services and fees in full. These are the services families ask us for most.

institutions.title: Recruiting in Vietnam? Start with the people who know the market.
institutions.lead: Capstone has worked with admissions teams since 2009. We put your school in front of students who are ready to apply, and we stay on the ground after you fly home.

items.title: Exhibit at our fairs
items.text: Meet pre-screened students and parents at our fairs in Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City.

items.title: Host an info session
items.text: A dedicated session for your school, with an audience we invite and follow up with.

items.title: In-country representation
items.text: Our counsellors represent your programmes year-round and handle applicant questions.

items.title: Market insight
items.text: Data on demand, pricing and visa trends to plan your Vietnam strategy.
